world.title: ‘If there are direct India-Taiwan flights, they will fly’: MEA after Pakistan blocks airspace over 'One-China' policy
world.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson stated that direct flights between India and Taiwan will operate if established, following Pakistan's decision to block airspace over its 'One-China' policy. This confirmation came after reports indicated that Taiwanese carriers were preparing to launch flights. The situation highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions and the complexities of international air travel in the region.

world.title: US midterms: Six days left - who leads in the polls as Trump, Obama rally
world.summary: With six days remaining before the November 3 midterm elections, Democrats are leading in national polls. However, several critical Senate races remain competitive. Former President Donald Trump and former President Barack Obama are actively campaigning in key states to rally support for their respective parties. The political landscape is dynamic as candidates prepare for the upcoming elections.

world.title: Serbian Police Kill Knife-Wielding Assailant After Attack on Officer Guarding Israeli Embassy in Belgrade
world.summary: Serbian police fatally shot a knife-wielding assailant who attacked an officer guarding the Israeli Embassy in Belgrade. The incident occurred shortly after midnight, resulting in the officer sustaining injuries. Authorities have launched a terrorist attack investigation and heightened security measures in response. The Interior Minister confirmed the details of the attack and the subsequent police action.

business.title: 2027 Maruti Fronx Facelift Spied - ADAS, New 1.2L 3 Cyl, Rear Disc Brake
business.summary: A camouflaged prototype of the 2027 Maruti Fronx facelift has been spotted, showcasing a revised grille and rear disc brakes. The vehicle is expected to feature Baleno-inspired equipment upgrades and a new 1.2L three-cylinder petrol engine. This development follows the recent launch of the Baleno facelift, indicating Maruti Suzuki's ongoing commitment to enhancing its vehicle lineup.

business.title: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan Explains
business.summary: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan noted that the global surge in AI stocks has nearly doubled their market capitalisation in three years, diverting liquidity from Indian equities. He emphasized India's absence of a robust AI narrative, which has led investors to favor markets in the US, Taiwan, and South Korea, although there are signs of capital returning to more established markets.

technology.title: Oct. 28 Return [2026]
technology.summary: Garena has announced that Free Fire India will launch on October 28, 2026, as a free standalone app for Android and iOS devices. The game will be available for download through the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Details regarding the launch and download process have been provided, clarifying what is confirmed and what remains uncertain.

technology.title: Motorola Signature 27 Launching India Next Month: Specs, Features And Availability
technology.summary: Motorola has announced the launch of its Signature 27 flagship smartphone in India, scheduled for November 2026. The device was initially unveiled at the Snapdragon Summit 2026 and later presented at the India Mobile Congress. Details regarding its specifications, features, and availability will be provided closer to the launch date, generating anticipation among potential consumers.

technology.title: iPhone Duo inner display cracking at same spot near fold, Apple confirms issue on some units
technology.summary: Apple has confirmed that some iPhone Duo units are experiencing cracks on the inner display near the fold. This issue has been reported by early buyers, with images shared on social media platforms. In response, Apple is offering replacements to affected users through AppleCare. The problem surfaced shortly after the foldable smartphone began shipping to customers.

sports.title: Shadman’s unbeaten knock anchors Bangladesh on day one
sports.summary: Bangladesh concluded day one of the ICC World Test Championship against West Indies at 213/3, with Shadman Islam remaining unbeaten on 99 runs. Despite early challenges from the West Indies bowlers, Shadman anchored the innings, providing stability for the team in Mirpur. His performance was crucial in establishing a solid foundation for Bangladesh in the match.

sports.title: Barcelona 16-year-old gem could be in contention for Alaves clash after training with first team
sports.summary: Ebrima Tunkara, a 16-year-old midfielder, has trained with Barcelona's first team ahead of their La Liga match against Alaves. This training session follows Barcelona's recent defeat in El Clasico. Coach Hansi Flick is evaluating his options for the upcoming game, and Tunkara's participation provides him with an opportunity to showcase his abilities to the coaching staff.

sports.title: Hamstring injury rules Prasidh Krishna out of New Zealand ODIs; Nabi set to be included
sports.summary: India fast bowler Prasidh Krishna has been ruled out of the five-match ODI series against New Zealand due to a hamstring injury. He is currently undergoing recovery and fitness tests, with the team management prioritizing his readiness for upcoming Test matches. Afghanistan's Mohammad Nabi is expected to be included in the squad as a replacement for Krishna.

health.title: The hidden toll of India's air pollution: How PM2.5 affects long-term health
health.summary: A Lancet study attributes 3.8 million deaths in India over 11 years to PM2.5 air pollution, highlighting significant long-term health risks. The findings stress the urgency for structural emission reductions and enhanced preventive healthcare measures. As air pollution persists in regions like Delhi-NCR, experts caution that its effects extend beyond immediate respiratory symptoms, impacting overall health.

health.title: Every minute matters in stroke care as delays can cost lives and even permanent paralysis
health.summary: A stroke is a medical emergency where timely intervention is crucial for survival and recovery. It occurs when blood supply to the brain is interrupted, either by a blocked vessel or a rupture causing bleeding. Delays in treatment can lead to severe outcomes, including permanent disability or death, highlighting the importance of rapid response in stroke care.

health.title: First In Vivo Trial for Wilson Disease
health.summary: Scientists have initiated the first in vivo prime editing trial for Wilson's disease, a genetic disorder affecting copper metabolism. The Phase 1/2 clinical trial has treated its first patient, marking a significant step in gene therapy research. Results from this groundbreaking study are anticipated, as researchers aim to evaluate the safety and efficacy of this innovative treatment approach.

science.title: If Dark Matter Exerts a Faint 'Pressure'… Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute Offers New Solution to the Cosmic Expansion Puzzle
science.summary: A research team at the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute has proposed a new model suggesting that dark matter may exert a faint "pressure," challenging previous assumptions. This concept could help address the cosmic expansion puzzle, as dark matter constitutes about 27% of the universe's mass but remains largely unidentified. Further studies are needed to explore this hypothesis.

science.title: Scientists found a 237-million-year-old marine amphibian. What does it reveal?
science.summary: Scientists have discovered a 237-million-year-old marine amphibian fossil from the Triassic period, indicating that some ancient amphibians adapted to marine environments. This finding highlights an important evolutionary principle: biological limitations can be transcended by repurposing existing features. The fossil record serves as a reminder of the complexities of evolution and the adaptability of life forms over time.

science.title: This 10-year-old Japanese student wants to know If butterflies remember their Caterpillar days. His research also raises questions about inherited memories
science.summary: A 10-year-old Japanese student, Jo Nagai, is exploring whether butterflies remember their caterpillar days and if they can pass learned behaviors to their offspring. His research taps into a longstanding scientific inquiry about memory retention and inheritance in insects. This investigation reflects his childhood fascination with butterflies and aims to contribute to the understanding of memory in animals.

entertainment.title: Katrina Kaif says Vicky Kaushal has a superpower of being 100 percent present as a father after 18 hours of work: 'An indescribable feeling to see Vihaan’s face and know that four years of a journey l
entertainment.summary: Katrina Kaif discussed her experiences as a mother and her relationship with husband Vicky Kaushal. She praised Vicky for his dedication as a supportive partner and hands-on father to their son, Vihaan. Kaif highlighted Vicky's ability to be fully present even after long work hours, expressing the joy of seeing Vihaan's face and reflecting on their parenting journey.

entertainment.title: Hanuman Ansh Final Worldwide Box Office Collections: Neem Karoli Baba film heads to close historic run at Rs 439 crore globally
entertainment.summary: The film "Hanuman Ansh" is nearing the end of its box office run, projected to finish with global collections around Rs. 439 crore. In its final week, it earned nearly Rs. 2 crore, marking the fifth-biggest Week 11 in history. The movie set multiple records during its run, particularly from Week 1 to Week 5.

entertainment.title: AR Rahman Reacts As Ramayana Song Mangal Rang Tops YouTube Music Charts Amid Online Debate
entertainment.summary: AR Rahman's song "Mangal Rang," from Nitesh Tiwari's upcoming film Ramayana, has topped YouTube Music charts. The track has ignited discussions online, with critics addressing its music and raising questions about a scene featuring Lord Rama and Sita. The song's popularity contrasts with the mixed reactions it has received, highlighting ongoing debates surrounding its artistic choices.
